label_contract: Known TE classes are P; ambiguous/Unknown annotations are ignored; other repeats and unannotated ACGT are comparator N, not certified biological negative. Non-ACGT is ignored. Ignore overrides P where annotations conflict.
evaluation: CAL-only calibration; old/new annotation results on EVAL cannot select checkpoints or thresholds. No new annotation used in training, calibration, or region selection. Chromosome holdout does not imply sequence-homology or pretraining independence.
